reason_for_separate_series: All 12 score-v4 configurations were consumed; stage 2 permits at most two additional v4.1 configurations.

hypothesis.measured_limitation: On S1-S4, corrected A2 reduced within-day opposing errors from B2 1875986 to 1813844 (-62142), but increased rounded daily SAE from 5037955 to 5229181 (+191226). This is a diagnostic decomposition, not a causal claim or an attainable-gain estimate.
hypothesis.exact_change: For every fold/route/date, preserve the exact B2 float daily sum and replace only its 24-hour allocation with the normalized nonnegative corrected-A2 forecast shape. P2 is the single preregistered 50% shrinkage toward that projected shape. No intermediate rounding.
hypothesis.novelty: A1/A2 changed both level and shape. C2/N2 predicted another daily level and used B2 as the hourly shape, which is the inverse construction. v2/v3 used historical shapes, and G1 changed only route-50 weekends. None projected A2 shape onto the B2 daily total.
hypothesis.past_data: Only the already frozen, past-only corrected A2 and exact B2 OOF predictions at each S origin. The transform does not read actual boardings. A2's internal calibrator training targets were restricted to dates available at its validation origin.
hypothesis.estimated_time: Under 5 minutes for S1-S4 because no model is refit; up to 25 minutes only if a frozen finalist requires diagnostic D/stress and final export.
hypothesis.admission_and_stop: Unchanged v4 guardrails. Stop after P1/P2 if neither passes. If both pass, freeze the higher S score; exact tie favors P2. Open D/stress only for the frozen finalist and do not tune after viewing them.

selection: highest S score among candidates passing every unchanged guardrail; exact tie favors P2; otherwise retain exact B2
